# Gate fixtures

Generated by `gen-fixtures.sh` from `tests/fixtures/scan/live38`; every
tree is tracked. One line per variant:

- base: healthy tree with ftrace on, full privilege, lockdown none.
- ftrace-off: ftrace_enabled reads 0.
- ftrace-denied: ftrace_enabled is fixture-denied.
- ftrace-malformed: ftrace_enabled holds non-numeric text.
- aff-dup: the map hook listed twice in available_filter_functions.
- aff-module: the map hook listed once with a module suffix.
- aff-clone: only a dotted clone of the map hook listed.
- aff-prefix: the map hook plus a longer name, no trailing newline.
- debugfs-root: tracefs tree moved under /sys/kernel/debug/tracing.
- debug-denied: debugfs tree present but fixture-denied at its parent.
